english:
Kills through any means during a Super grant Super Energy after the Super ends. Kills with Super damage while outside a Super grant Super Energy immediately instead.

The Super Energy refund follows the same progression for either type of kill: ~5?%|?%|?%|?%|?%|~33% after 1|2|3|4|5|6 kills, capped at ~33%.

Casting a Super resets the refund cap. Removing Supercyclical and reacquiring the 4-piece bonus by changing gear also resets the cap.

// Source does not establish whether the out-of-Super percentages are cumulative refunds or separate gains on each kill.

source.text:
4 Piece | Supercyclical

Upon scoring kills while in a Super Ability:
x1 = ~5?% | x2 = ?% | x3 = ?% | x4 = ?% | x5 = ?% | x6 = ~33% Super Ability Energy once it ends.

Upon scoring kills with Super Damage while NOT in a Super Ability:
x1 = ~5?% | x2 = ?% | x3 = ?% | x4 = ?% | x5 = ?% | x6 = ~33% Super Ability Energy.

Super Ability Refund Cap is reset on Super Ability Cast or upon swaping off of Supercyclical and then reacquiring the 4 Piece Perk by changing gear.
